incidents.text: Goal! Franck Kessie (Ivory Coast) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
Half-time substitution. Nico Schlotterbeck (Germany) is replaced by Antonio Rudiger.
That's the end of the game for Leroy Sane, who is replaced by Jamie Leweling (Germany).
Julian Nagelsmann has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Deniz Undav (Germany) replacing Jamal Musiala.
Nadiem Amiri (Germany) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Aleksandar Pavlovic.
Deniz Undav (Germany) meets a perfect cross from Nadiem Amiri deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike into the roof of the net. It's 1:1.
Emerse Fae has decided to substitute Ange-Yoan Bonny and he is replaced by Evann Guessand (Ivory Coast).
The manager makes a subsitution with Seko Fofana (Ivory Coast) coming on for Ibrahim Sangare.
Here is a change. Amad Diallo is going off and Emerse Fae gives the last tactical orders to Simon Adingra (Ivory Coast).
Emerse Fae is forced to make a change. Wilfried Singo (Ivory Coast) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Guela Doue.
The referee signals a substitution. Nicolas Pepe (Ivory Coast) is brought on as a substitute for Yan Diomande.
Julian Nagelsmann has decided to make a change. Leon Goretzka (Germany) replaces Kai Havertz.
Goal! Deniz Undav (Germany) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Felix Nmecha, then sends the ball low into the middle of the net. 2:1.
